feedbackSql: SELECT m.model_id, m.model_version, m.config_revision, COUNT(CASE WHEN f.rating = 'helpful' THEN 1 END) AS helpful, COUNT(CASE WHEN f.rating = 'incorrect' THEN 1 END) AS incorrect, COUNT(CASE WHEN f.rating = 'insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS insufficient FROM n_ai_moderation_feedback f JOIN n_ai_messages m ON m.message_id = f.message_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.model_version, m.config_revision ORDER BY m.config_revision DESC NULLS LAST, m.model_id, m.model_version FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
